paper.title: No Representation, No Trust: Connecting Representation, Collapse, and Trust Issues in PPO

author_source.license: MIT; retained original notice; PyTorch task adapter of disclosed core with own collector

scientific_core.actor: PPO clipped surrogate epsilon.2 plus lambda1 detached behavior preactivation mean-squared drift penalty
scientific_core.distribution: Tanh Normal with state-dependent positive scale; density of actual executed bounded action including correct transform Jacobian
scientific_core.anchors: Actual collection-time object and total head preactivation features; each feeds loc and state-dependent scale; detached before any update
scientific_core.advantages: GAE lambda1 gamma.99 with population minibatch normalization and sqrt clamp1e-6
scientific_core.value: Separate Adam on un-clipped coefficient.5 squared value loss
scientific_core.clipping: Separate actor and value gradient norms.5
scientific_core.optimizer: Adam lr3e-4 eps1e-8, no learning-rate annealing

declared_task_adaptations: Serial512 rollout,8 minibatches64,10epochs; finite physical episode terminals. Author large parallel-task sample schedule is not reproduced.
Compact public observations and shared object/total actor representation; head-balanced feature MSE is a declared task adaptation.
Both actual head representations feed loc and scale; no global action standard deviation inherited from SPO.

64x64 orthogonal critic and private serial collector initialization inherited only as engineering infrastructure from independently validated SPO port. PPO/PFO objective, distribution, entropy and optimizers are overridden.
Private action/learning RNGs and dev-only inference; no observation or reward running normalization. Native environment reward is unchanged; internal scale1.
No privileged state, offline data, pretrained policy, environment model, target network or replay; independent online-from-scratch methods.
limits: The author underlying TorchRL/TensorDict distribution version is unpinned. Torch mathematical TanhNormal/default biased-softplus semantics are ported without large dependencies; full author runtime and bitwise author rollout equivalence are not claimed.

Equal-head reduction is algebraically equivalent to official feature-MSE on explicitly rescaled concatenated features; this is a task reduction adaptation, not the untouched single-flat-trunk author architecture.
These CPU synthetic tests establish implementation math and isolation, not physical task full-spend or learning success. Parent owns actual native CUDA gates.

formal100608_tail_revision.behavior: Every real tail transition is used in four64-sample minibatches per epoch; ten epochs; no extra collection
